tasks.short: Prepare sketches or follow electrical blueprints

steps.what: Inspect the site and read current blueprints, specifications and applicable building and safety requirements
outputs: understood wiring locations and site discrepancies

steps.what: Prepare sketches or mark blueprint locations and check their conformance with applicable requirements
inputs: understood wiring locations and site discrepancies
outputs: checked location sketch or interpreted blueprint

tasks.design: Retain electrician-led site interpretation and sketching using current documents {DOCS} and existing drawing tools {OTHER}. No generated wiring location or automated code-conformance decision is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drawings must be reconciled with the actual site and applicable requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Current drawing tools already assist sketching; paperwork products in the digest do not establish automated electrical design.
tasks.still_hard: Identify drawing discrepancies and determine whether a proposed location is appropriate.
tasks.human_edge: Relate design intent to physical conditions and raise unresolved conflicts.
tasks.altitude: Reliable spatial interpretation remains accountable to the electrician.

reach.learn: Which design clarifications are needed before installation

evidence.claim: The digest's work-order tools do not demonstrate automated wiring-location or conformance decisions.

assumptions: The designer supplies current blueprints and specifications through the existing project process; revision uncertainty is resolved within retained review time.
The electrician produces site observations in s1 and sketch annotations in s2; capture and checking remain fully counted.
Applicable requirements are verified for the project rather than inferred from a generic model.
This task identifies and represents locations; detailed installation planning is a separate, potentially overlapping task and savings are not added.
No new drawing service or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Drawing revision controls and existing drawing tools
research_questions: Which site discrepancies most often prevent reliance on current blueprints?

already_counted.description: Site interpretation, sketching and conformance review remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new design tool or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and no incremental work give zero saving. Existing drawing aids are already in the baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check electrician license or identification requirements, expiry dates and renewal instructions
Complete required learning or assessment and submit credential renewal evidence
Confirm renewal acceptance and retain current electrician license or identification evidence
outputs: current credential evidence or unresolved renewal issue

tasks.design: Keep credential maintenance with the electrician using the relevant issuing portal {GOV_PORTAL} and retained evidence {DOCS}. Existing personal reminders can remain, but no new saving is claimed from reminders or from completing actual competence requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements vary by credential and must be satisfied by the individual.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing portals and document storage support renewal without a new model.
tasks.still_hard: Establish which credential applies and obtain acceptance before expiry.
tasks.human_edge: Complete required learning and verify personal eligibility and evidence.
tasks.altitude: Maintain valid evidence of required qualification.

reach.task: Clarify relevant renewal evidence and deadlines
reach.learn: Which credentials apply to the electrician's work

evidence.claim: Credential renewal requirements are jurisdiction and credential dependent; no universal electrician licence regime is assumed.

assumptions: The task applies only where a government-required licence or identification is relevant; local applicability must be checked.
The issuing body produces current instructions and acceptance; the electrician verifies dates in s1 and captures current evidence in s3, with all capture time retained.
Actual learning, assessment and submission remain in s2; no free expiry register or automatic eligibility decision is introduced.
No new reminder system or upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which exact credentials and renewal activities apply to this worker?

already_counted.description: Requirement verification, renewal and acceptance checking remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new credential registry or maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and no incremental work give zero saving. Actual learning or credential obligations are not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review job specifications, local requirements and site constraints for electrical installation
outputs: verified installation constraints and open design questions

steps.what: Plan wiring, equipment and fixture layout and installation sequence and resolve design conflicts
inputs: verified installation constraints and open design questions

tasks.design: Retain electrician-led layout and installation planning with specifications {DOCS} and existing drawing tools {OTHER}. No generative layout or automatic interpretation of local requirements is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan must fit site constraints, design requirements and a practical installation sequence.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing drawing and document tools support planning; the digest supports work records rather than automated planning.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicts with other trades and recognise when design authority must clarify a requirement.
tasks.human_edge: Combine physical site knowledge with technical judgement.
tasks.altitude: Keep installation planning grounded in verified conditions.

reach.task: Coordinate unresolved installation conflicts with other trades
reach.learn: Which constraints alter the practical sequence

evidence.claim: Digital work-order capabilities do not establish automated electrical installation planning or conformance review.

assumptions: The designer supplies specifications and drawings; the electrician produces verified site constraints in s1 with all capture time retained.
The electrician creates and checks the plan in s2; no free structured site model or resolved code table is assumed.
This task overlaps sketch preparation in practice; no cross-task additive saving is claimed.
Existing tools remain and no new upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Design authority boundaries and site coordination process
research_questions: Which recurring design conflicts consume planning time and require external clarification?

already_counted.description: Constraint verification and installation planning remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new planning service or data maintenance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and no incremental work give zero saving. Planning judgement and site review retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess workers' understanding and explain the electrical work, responsibilities and safe working boundaries
outputs: explained work responsibilities and instruction needs

steps.what: Direct or train workers installing, maintaining or repairing electrical wiring, equipment or fixtures
inputs: explained work responsibilities and instruction needs

tasks.design: Keep direction, demonstrations and correction with the electrician, using existing work instructions {DOCS}. No learning bot, worker score or automatic competence judgement replaces observation of real work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe practice and understanding must be assessed in the actual work context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instructions support the encounter; a new digital step is not needed for this design.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise misunderstanding and intervene at the right moment.
tasks.human_edge: Demonstrate technique and adapt instruction to observed practice.
tasks.altitude: Preserve attentive supervision and practical learning.

evidence.claim: Instruction and supervision of real electrical work retain human observation and correction in this design.

assumptions: The project supervisor supplies the approved work scope; current instructions are already maintained outside this task.
The electrician assesses understanding in s1 and observes and corrects practice in s2; all assessment and teaching time remains.
No free structured competence score or new worker monitoring feed is assumed.
Learner time remains unchanged and excluded from focal savings; no new content system or upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which practical misunderstandings require repeated demonstration?

already_counted.description: Assessment, instruction and supervision remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new training system or content upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 with no incremental work yield zero saving. Learner practice and real supervision are not reduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain electrical design interpretation, practical planning and worker supervision.
reach: Resolve drawing conflicts with site supervision
Clarify credential obligations with training staff
role.ambitious_version: An electrician who makes plans and safe working expectations clear while retaining site-based judgement.
